annotations.text:
Saudi Job Alert - redesign

Dark by default: Fragments' warm
#171614 ground, coss/ui's 10px radii
and 36px controls.

Accent switches amber <-> azure,
remembered per browser.

Also here: posting timestamps, the
72-hour freshness badge, 12-hour and
All time windows, and removal for
dead postings.

Same system at 390px. No fake status
bar - the real one renders above this.
Chip rails scroll; tap targets stay 40px+.
